body:
All six chapters are written and verified.

| File | Size | Distinct citations |
|---|---:|---:|
| `16-client-integration.md` | 8,977 B | 17 |
| `17-production-deployment.md` | 8,999 B | 24 |
| `18-operations-and-troubleshooting.md` | 8,989 B | 18 |
| `19-upgrade-and-maintenance.md` | 8,996 B | 16 |
| `20-decisions-and-pitfalls.md` | 8,999 B | 18 |
| `21-quick-reference.md` | 9,407 B | 34 |

Checks performed:
- Every file starts `# NN — ...`, ends with `## Sources`, and is English-only.
- Every `path:line` / `path:start-end` citation resolves against `/tmp/litellm-src`; zero missing files or out-of-range lines.
- Every cited `docs.litellm.ai` URL returned HTTP 200.
- Used and listed sources match in both directions; no orphan citations.
- 20 contains the JWT source `litellm/rust/crates/gateway-auth-core/src/error.rs:70` and the five-user SSO gate `litellm/proxy/utils.py:7023`.
- 19 is 8,996 B, well under 10 KB.
- 17 has an explicit go-live checklist table covering workers/HPA, Redis, Postgres pool, migrations, probes/drain, image/secrets, filesystem, and job roles.
- Budget status corrected to 422 (`litellm/__init__.py:394`), with 429 reserved for rate/parallel limits.
- No files outside my six assignments were modified.
